exposure: magnesium sulfate administration during cesarean delivery
cohort: 124 patients with preeclampsia with severe features or eclampsia at time of CD
finding: Magnesium sulfate administration for seizure prevention in patients with preeclampsia with severe features at the time of CD does not appear to be associated with an increase in the cEBL.
mod_finding: Magnesium sulfate administration for seizure prevention in patients with preeclampsia with severe features at the time of cesarean delivery does not appear to be associated with an increase in the cEBL.
